versions.changelog:
Initial release of camino-safety-checker.

- Find 24-hour businesses, well-lit public areas, transit stations, police stations, and hospitals near any location.
- Shell script and API usage examples for quick integration.
- Requires CAMINO_API_KEY environment variable.
- Provides instant trial with 25 calls—no signup required.
- Structured API response highlights safety resources within configurable radius.
- Part of Camino AI location intelligence suite; companion skills available.
